$comment: S19 Google Open Buildings v3 (T070). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s19.yaml.

fields.name: building_id
fields.meaning: full_plus_code; no building ID is published, and the release plus the Plus Code is unique

fields.name: geometry
fields.meaning: footprint polygon, WKT converted to WKB, WGS84

fields.name: confidence
fields.meaning: model score 0.65 to 1.0; the map shows 0.75 or more by default

valid_at: null: one static release; rows carry no image dates
clip: rows whose centroid lies in the requested box; duplicate Plus Codes within a release are dropped
not_included: owners, residents, addresses and building use: none are published and none are inferred
